mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (user_id, title, content, board_id, image_url) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{boardType}, #{imageUrl})
mapper.select: SELECT id, board_id, user_id, created_at, updated_at, view_count, title, content, image_url, like_count, is_delete FROM posts WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT post_id, title, content, image_url, created_at, updated_at, view_count, like_count FROM posts ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId}
